description:
Presenting  ‘Coonawarra’, a substantial four-bedroom detached family home combining generous accommodation, period character and a sought-after Killiney address. Part of the rear and the side gardens are not included as there is FPP for 2 detached houses - planning permission under reference D25A/0792.

Built in the 1940s, the property extends to approximately 219 sq. m (2,357 sq. ft), with an additional attic conversion of approximately 23 sq. m (247 sq. ft). Bright, well-proportioned interiors and a choice of reception rooms provide excellent space for both everyday family life and entertaining.

A welcoming entrance hall leads to the spacious front reception room, where a newly installed stove creates an inviting focal point. A separate dining room connects through double pocket doors to the family room, allowing the rooms to work equally well as individual spaces or together for larger gatherings. The adjoining conservatory enjoys an outlook over the rear garden and provides a peaceful setting in which to relax.

The kitchen/breakfast room overlooks the garden and is complemented by a separate pantry and rear porch. A utility room with guest WC completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, a generous landing serves four bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with an en suite shower room and walk-in wardrobe. A family bathroom and separate WC are also located on this level. A staircase leads to the converted attic, arranged as three attic rooms, with sea views to Dun Laoghaire and Howth from this elevated position.

Coonawarra enjoys a convenient setting close to the amenities of Killiney, Dalkey and Glenageary. Local shops, cafés, restaurants and a choice of schools are within easy reach, together with coastal walks and the open spaces of Killiney Hill. DART and bus services provide connections to the city centre and surrounding areas.

The house is offered with a reduced garden area, following the separation of two sites within the original grounds. These sites benefit from full planning permission for two houses and are being offered for sale separately. They are not included in the €1,250,000 asking price for Coonawarra.
